Sub BGColor () If pv_1 == Nothing Then I_Text.text = "Ош." body.fill = Color_ErLink Exit Sub End If Dim res As Byte If !Ignore_BAD Then If pv_1.Quality == PLS_QUAL_BAD Then I_Text.text = "НДСТ" body.fill = Color_Inval Exit Sub End If If pv_2 != Nothing Then If pv_2.Quality == PLS_QUAL_BAD Then I_Text.text = "НДСТ" body.fill = Color_Inval Exit Sub End If End If If pv_3 != Nothing Then If pv_3.Quality == PLS_QUAL_BAD Then I_Text.text = "НДСТ" body.fill = Color_Inval Exit Sub End If End If If pv_4 != Nothing Then If pv_4.Quality == PLS_QUAL_BAD Then I_Text.text = "НДСТ" body.fill = Color_Inval Exit Sub End If End If End If res = 0 If pv_1_bit == -1 Then res = pv_1.Value & 1 Else If PRJSPEC.DetectBit(pv_1, (16 - pv_1_bit)) Then res = 1 End If End If If pv_2 != Nothing Then If pv_2_bit == -1 Then res = res | ((pv_2.Value & 1) * 2) Else If PRJSPEC.DetectBit(pv_2, (16 - pv_2_bit)) Then res = res | 2 End If End If End If If pv_3 != Nothing Then If pv_3_bit == -1 Then res = res | ((pv_3.Value & 1) * 4) Else If PRJSPEC.DetectBit(pv_3, (16 - pv_3_bit)) Then res = res | 4 End If End If End If If pv_4 != Nothing Then If pv_4_bit == -1 Then res = res | ((pv_4.Value & 1) * 8) Else If PRJSPEC.DetectBit(pv_4, (16 - pv_4_bit)) Then res = res | 8 End If End If End If
If res == 0 Then I_Text.text = Text_0000 body.fill = Color_0000 If Blink_on_0000 Then Blink_on = True Else Blink_on = False End If ElseIf res == 1 Then I_Text.text = Text_0001 body.fill = Color_0001 If Blink_on_0001 Then Blink_on = True Else Blink_on = False End If ElseIf res == 2 Then I_Text.text = Text_0010 body.fill = Color_0010 If Blink_on_0010 Then Blink_on = True Else Blink_on = False End If ElseIf res == 3 Then I_Text.text = Text_0011 body.fill = Color_0011 If Blink_on_0011 Then Blink_on = True Else Blink_on = False End If ElseIf res == 4 Then I_Text.text = Text_0100 body.fill = Color_0100 If Blink_on_0100 Then Blink_on = True Else Blink_on = False End If ElseIf res == 5 Then I_Text.text = Text_0101 body.fill = Color_0101 If Blink_on_0101 Then Blink_on = True Else Blink_on = False End If ElseIf res == 6 Then I_Text.text = Text_0110 body.fill = Color_0110 If Blink_on_0110 Then Blink_on = True Else Blink_on = False End If ElseIf res == 7 Then I_Text.text = Text_0111 body.fill = Color_0111 If Blink_on_0111 Then Blink_on = True Else Blink_on = False End If ElseIf res == 8 Then I_Text.text = Text_1000 body.fill = Color_1000 If Blink_on_1000 Then Blink_on = True Else Blink_on = False End If ElseIf res == 9 Then I_Text.text = Text_1001 body.fill = Color_1001 If Blink_on_1001 Then Blink_on = True Else Blink_on = False End If ElseIf res == 10 Then I_Text.text = Text_1010 body.fill = Color_1010 If Blink_on_1010 Then Blink_on = True Else Blink_on = False End If ElseIf res == 11 Then I_Text.text = Text_1011 body.fill = Color_1011 If Blink_on_1011 Then Blink_on = True Else Blink_on = False End If ElseIf res == 12 Then I_Text.text = Text_1100 body.fill = Color_1100 If Blink_on_1100 Then Blink_on = True Else Blink_on = False End If ElseIf res == 13 Then I_Text.text = Text_1101 body.fill = Color_1101 If Blink_on_1101 Then Blink_on = True Else Blink_on = False End If ElseIf res == 14 Then I_Text.text = Text_1110 body.fill = Color_1110 If Blink_on_1110 Then Blink_on = True Else Blink_on = False End If ElseIf res == 15 Then I_Text.text = Text_1111 body.fill = Color_1111 If Blink_on_1111 Then Blink_on = True Else Blink_on = False End If End If End Sub
rt:model.rt:event: Dim Tmp_PID As String Dim bit_num As String If (PointID_1 != "NULL") then Tmp_PID = PRJSPEC.ComSplit(PointID_1, bit_num) pv_1 = BIN(Tmp_PID) If IsNumericString(bit_num) Then pv_1_bit = CByte(bit_num) If (pv_1_bit < 0) || (pv_1_bit > 16) Then pv_1_bit = -1 End If End If Else body.fill = Color_ErLink End If If (PointID_2 != "NULL") then Tmp_PID = PRJSPEC.ComSplit(PointID_2, bit_num) pv_2 = BIN(Tmp_PID) If IsNumericString(bit_num) Then pv_2_bit = CByte(bit_num) If (pv_2_bit < 0) || (pv_2_bit > 16) Then pv_2_bit = -1 End If End If End If If (PointID_3 != "NULL") then Tmp_PID = PRJSPEC.ComSplit(PointID_3, bit_num) pv_3 = BIN(Tmp_PID) If IsNumericString(bit_num) Then pv_3_bit = CByte(bit_num) If (pv_3_bit < 0) || (pv_3_bit > 16) Then pv_3_bit = -1 End If End If End If If (PointID_4 != "NULL") then Tmp_PID = PRJSPEC.ComSplit(PointID_4, bit_num) pv_4 = BIN(Tmp_PID) If IsNumericString(bit_num) Then pv_4_bit = CByte(bit_num) If (pv_4_bit < 0) || (pv_4_bit > 16) Then pv_4_bit = -1 End If End If End If

If Blink_on && Ack_Allowed Then Blink_on = False Exit Sub End If If PointID_1 == "NULL" Then ShowWarning ("Объект не привязан.", 5) ElseIf (pv_1 == Nothing) Then NoLink (PointID_1) ElseIf (PointID_2 != "NULL") && (pv_2 == Nothing) Then NoLink (PointID_2) ElseIf (PointID_3 != "NULL") && (pv_3 == Nothing) Then NoLink (PointID_3) ElseIf (PointID_4 != "NULL") && (pv_4 == Nothing) Then NoLink (PointID_4) ElseIf (pv_2 == Nothing) && (pv_3 == Nothing) && (pv_4 == Nothing) Then Call_Win("wi_BIN", pv_1.PVId) Else Dim s As String s = pv_1.PVId + "|" + pv_2.PVId If (pv_3 != Nothing) Then s = s + "|" + pv_3.PVId End If If (pv_4 != Nothing) Then s = s + "|" + pv_4.PVId End If Open_Win_Uni(False, "multyKKS", "Составной объект", "wi_MultyPV", s) End If

If PointID_1 == "NULL" Then ShowWarning ("Объект не привязан.", 5) ElseIf (pv_1 == Nothing) Then NoLink (PointID_1) ElseIf (PointID_2 != "NULL") && (pv_2 == Nothing) Then NoLink (PointID_2) ElseIf (PointID_3 != "NULL") && (pv_3 == Nothing) Then NoLink (PointID_3) ElseIf (PointID_4 != "NULL") && (pv_4 == Nothing) Then NoLink (PointID_4) ElseIf (pv_2 == Nothing) && (pv_3 == Nothing) && (pv_4 == Nothing) Then LoadPopUpMenu(pv_1.PVId + "|BINi|wi_BIN " + pv_1.PVId) Else Dim s As String s = pv_1.PVId + "|" + pv_2.PVId TmpBuffer(0) = pv_1.PVId TmpBuffer(1) = pv_2.PVId If (pv_3 != Nothing) Then TmpBuffer(2) = pv_3.PVId s = s + "|" + pv_3.PVId End If If (pv_4 != Nothing) Then TmpBuffer(3) = pv_4.PVId s = s + "|" + pv_4.PVId End If LoadPopUpMenu(pv_1.PVId + "|NONi|") End If
